name: my-ride
description: My Ride - e-hailing web ecosystem (marketing + customer + driver + admin) in one web app

scripts.db:init: /usr/bin/node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); require('dotenv').config(); const dbPath=process.env.SQLITE_PATH||'./mycab.sqlite'; const schema=fs.readFileSync(path.join('db','schema.sql'),'utf8'); const db=new Database(dbPath); db.exec(schema); db.close(); console.log('DB initialized at', dbPath);"
